scientific_stage: M3 local-only blocked cross-validation of the Gibbs concentration parameter lambda
purpose: Determine the M3 Gibbs concentration parameter from public I1 alone, before any M3 graph simulation, instead of fixing lambda from trajectory count or choosing it from an ESS target.

historical_notes.v1_lambda100: Executed locally and archived. It collapsed the weighted distribution to joint ESS about 1.68 and only 3 unique combinations in 200 draws. No M3 graph simulation was run.
historical_notes.v2_lambda5: Proposed after the concentration audit but superseded before execution because ESS>=3 is a design heuristic rather than a derivation of the weighting concentration.

cross_validation.unit: complete region_rho x query_rho horizon curve
cross_validation.fold_property: each fold contains five complete horizon curves and contains each region_rho and each query_rho exactly once
cross_validation.candidate_energy_on_training: mean Bernoulli KL D(p_I1_Jeffreys || p_theta_Jeffreys) over all training points
cross_validation.validation_prediction: weighted mixture of candidate Jeffreys-smoothed sigma probabilities at held-out points
cross_validation.validation_score_primary: mean Bernoulli KL D(p_I1_Jeffreys || p_mix) on held-out points
cross_validation.validation_score_secondary: mean squared probability error on held-out points
cross_validation.provider_aggregation: equal weight to ProviderA, ProviderB, ProviderC
cross_validation.fold_aggregation: equal weight to the five folds within each provider
cross_validation.independence_caveat: folds are structural holdouts of the public I1 surface, not independent datasets; CV is used for predictive hyperparameter selection, not confidence-interval inference

selection_rule.primary: select lambda with minimum mean held-out Bernoulli KL averaged equally over all provider-fold cells
selection_rule.tie_breaker: if primary scores are equal within 1e-12, choose the smaller lambda
selection_rule.boundary_behavior: if the selected lambda is the largest grid value, report boundary selection explicitly and do not extend the grid after seeing the result; treat this as evidence that the weighted predictor prefers near-selection under the frozen grid

post_selection.recompute_full_surface_provider_weights: use selected global lambda on the full 1200-point public-I1 surface per candidate
post_selection.sampling: independent categorical draws with replacement from the factorized provider weights

next_gate: Only after the selected lambda, full-surface weights, and ordered 200-draw joint bank are materialized and hash-frozen may the equal-budget M3 graph contract be defined.
